Courses & Programme Outcomes
Department of Assamese: South Salmara College
Programme Outcome and Course Outcome
Name of The Programme: Assamese Honour Course(UG
)
Programme Outcome:
From UG Assamese Honour programme students will be able to learn broadely about the history of Assamese Language and Literature and also they will be learn various Early, Romantic and Modern Assamese Poems, Short stories, Novels, Dramas and Proses. Students will able to learn about Literature and Assamese Culture as well as dialects of Assamese Language. After passing out with major in Assamese students can opt for Post Graduate in Literature, Linguistics and Cultural Studies and after that they can also opt for Research Course. They can engage themselves as teaching related jobs(In Schools, Colleges and Universities) and jobs like Reporter, Proofreader, News-reader etc.
Programme Specific Outcome:
After completion of the programme students will gain informationson the Assamese culture and tradition. The course will provide skills in creative writing and competence in Asaamese Language and empower them with communicative skills. It gives knowledge on the life of famous Assamese Poets and Authors as well as their famous literary works.
